transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling TechBridge Solutions. This is Sarah speaking. How can I assist you today?

Customer: Hi, Sarah. I’m having some trouble with the billing. I was supposed to be charged $29.99 for the Basic plan, but I see a charge of $39.99.

Agent: I’m sorry to hear that, and I can certainly help you with that. Can you please confirm the email address associated with your account?

Customer: Sure, it’s john.doe@email.com. 

Agent: Thank you, John. Just a moment while I pull up your account. It looks like there was an upgrade to the Pro plan that was processed last month. Did you intend to upgrade?

Customer: No! I thought I signed up for the Basic plan only. I don't need those extra features.

Agent: I understand how confusing this can be. We can revert your account back to the Basic plan, and I’ll ensure the billing reflects that change.

Customer: Great, could you also make sure I get a refund for the extra charge?

Agent: Absolutely. I can request a refund for the $39.99 charge right now, and it should reflect in your account within 3-5 business days.

Customer: That's a relief! Thanks. I just don’t want this to happen again.

Agent: I completely understand. To prevent future issues, I recommend checking your account settings regularly, or you can enable billing notifications for any changes.

Customer: That sounds good. How do I enable those notifications?

Agent: Just log into the portal, go to 'Settings,' and select 'Notifications.’ There, you can customize which alerts you’d like to receive.

Customer: Perfect. I’ll do that. Can you confirm when the refund is processed?

Agent: I’ll send you a confirmation email once the request is approved. Would you like me to follow up in a few days to ensure everything's resolved?

Customer: Yes, please! I appreciate your help today, Sarah.

Agent: My pleasure, John! I’ll follow up early next week. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out in the meantime. Have a great day!

Customer: Thank you! You too.
